dataset.source: VCTK-RVA (Voice Cloning Toolkit - Respeaker Voice Attributes). Elo ratings from consented multi-rater pair comparisons across train.txt, seen.txt, and unseen.txt comparison pools. Brightness/softness/impression labels derived from gender-normalized Elo scores rescaled to [0,1].
placeholderDims: stability (constant 0.5 until a consented multi-rater source is secured)

evaluation.split: speaker-disjoint, brightness-decile stratified (seed 20260727): train 81 / validation 10 / test 10

modelCard: Voiceprint voice-impression model (voice-4dim-vctk-101-v1, 1.0.0). Predicts four [0,1] tendency dimensions for a 20-second mono waveform: impression, brightness, softness, stability. Trained speaker-disjoint on 101 VCTK-RVA speakers (81/10/10 train/val/test) with brightness-decile stratification. Labels: brightness/softness/impression are consented multi-rater VCTK-RVA Elo scores (gender-normalized, rescaled to [0,1]); stability is a 0.5 placeholder constant pending a consented multi-rater source, so stability predictions are not interpretable. Held-out test loss (smooth_l1) 0.0278; Expected Calibration Error 0.0897 averaged across dims (impression 0.146, brightness 0.082, softness 0.130, stability ~0). ONNX export parity max absolute error 2.28e-28 (tolerance 1e-4). Inference is on-device in the browser via ONNX Runtime Web; no audio leaves the device. Not a speaker identification model; outputs are tendency scores, not identities. Do not use stability output until a consented multi-rater stability label source replaces the placeholder.

modelOutputs.note: Random waveform produces extreme outputs (not real speech). Proves ONNX produces 4-dim report-grade outputs. stability≈0.5 confirms placeholder behavior.
